name: Enel Chile S.A.
summary: Enel Chile S.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration, development, operation, generation, distribution, transmission, transformation, and sale of electricity in Chile and internationally. It operates in two segments, Generation and Distribution and Networks. The company generates and sells energy from renewable sources, including wind, hydroelectric, solar photovoltaic, and geothermal power, as well as energy storage systems; and transports and sells fuels. It is also involved in consulting services; financial assets investments; and civil and hydraulic engineering works.
